template_metadata.name: Interface Contracts Template
template_metadata.description: Template for documenting interface contracts for behavior preservation during migration
template_metadata.critical_note: Interface contracts are the foundation for behavior preservation - completeness is critical

contracts.interface_id: REPLACE: Unique identifier for this interface (e.g., UserManagementAPI)
contracts.interface_type: REPLACE: rest_api, grpc, graphql, function_module, database, message_queue, file_system

location.file: REPLACE: Path to file where interface is defined

operations.name: REPLACE: Operation/function name
operations.method: REPLACE: HTTP method for APIs (GET, POST, etc.) or null
operations.path: REPLACE: URL path for APIs or function signature

parameters.name: REPLACE: Parameter name
parameters.type: REPLACE: Type (string, integer, boolean, object, array)
parameters.description: REPLACE: What this parameter is for

enum: REPLACE: List of allowed values if applicable

success.status_code: REPLACE: HTTP status code (e.g., 200, 201) or null for functions

side_effects.type: REPLACE: database_write, database_read, network_call, file_write, file_read, event_emit, cache_update
side_effects.target: REPLACE: Target of side effect (table name, file path, service name)

operations.idempotent: REPLACE: true if calling multiple times has same effect as once, false otherwise
operations.timeout_ms: REPLACE: Expected timeout in milliseconds or null

rate_limit.window_seconds: REPLACE: Time window for rate limit

required_roles: REPLACE: List of roles that can access this operation

state_dependencies.type: REPLACE: database, cache, session, file, external_service
state_dependencies.name: REPLACE: Name of dependency
state_dependencies.description: REPLACE: How this interface depends on this state
required_for: REPLACE: List of operations that need this state

invariants.description: REPLACE: Condition that must always be true
invariants.verification: REPLACE: How to verify this invariant holds

preconditions.setup: REPLACE: How to set up this precondition

expected_side_effects.verification: REPLACE: How to verify side effect occurred

postconditions.description: REPLACE: Condition that should be true after test

standard_error_format.error_field: REPLACE: Field name for error message
standard_error_format.code_field: REPLACE: Field name for error code
standard_error_format.details_field: REPLACE: Field name for additional details

parameters.size_param: REPLACE: Parameter name for page size

response_fields.next_page_field: REPLACE: Field for next page cursor/offset

logging_and_tracing.correlation_id_header: REPLACE: Header name for correlation/request ID
logging_and_tracing.log_format: REPLACE: Structured log format if any

data_contracts.contract_id: REPLACE: Unique identifier for data contract
data_contracts.name: REPLACE: Data type name (e.g., User, Order)
data_contracts.description: REPLACE: What this data type represents

validation_rules.field: REPLACE: Field this rule applies to
validation_rules.error_message: REPLACE: Error message when validation fails

baseline_test_results.execution_date: REPLACE: When baseline tests were run
baseline_test_results.total_tests: REPLACE: Total number of golden tests

results.actual_output: REPLACE: Actual output from source implementation
results.notes: REPLACE: Any notes about this test result

limitations: REPLACE: Any limitations in extraction (e.g., couldn't extract from dynamically generated endpoints)
manual_review_needed: REPLACE: Areas that need manual contract verification
assumptions: REPLACE: Any assumptions made during extraction
